deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is the opening sheet of 'Aetherbewegungen I', part of Riemann's programme of a unified ether theory of gravitation and light (the same programme as the Nachlass fragments 'Neue mathematische Principien der Naturphilosophie' and 'Gravitation und Licht', printed in the Werke, 1876).

(A) Physical hypothesis (left column, top). Fill all of space with a homogeneous substance. Postulate two things.
- The velocity of the substance at each geometric point equals, in direction and magnitude, the resultant gravitational force at that point (or its exact opposite).
- This motion is identical with the motion of the luminiferous medium of the undulatory theory, i.e. the substance IS the light ether.
Riemann then claims: if the substance was everywhere equally dense at one instant, it stays uniformly distributed at all times. On this ground he proposes to call the substance 'der physische Raum'.
[My gloss] With v = grad V and div v = -4*pi*rho (see below), the continuity equation D(sigma)/Dt = -sigma*div v gives D(sigma)/Dt = 0 wherever rho = 0. So the claim holds in matter-free space only. Inside ponderable matter it requires Riemann's known extra hypothesis that ether flowing into the bodies vanishes there (sink). That hypothesis is not stated on this page.

(B) Characterisation of the Newtonian potential (left column). Assume all gravitating mass lies in a bounded region. Then V satisfies:
- (i) Laplacian(V) = -4*pi*rho;
- (ii) V = 0 for r = infinity;
- (iii) r * dV/dn = 0 at infinity, where r is the distance from the origin and n is the normal to a surface.
Right column, top: conversely, these three conditions suffice to determine V.
Let (x,y,z) be the coordinates of the geometric point and (x1',y1',z1') the gravity-determined velocity of the substance. By hypothesis v = grad V, so dV = x1' dx + y1' dy + z1' dz. Taking G = 1 and V = integral of rho/r dtau, grad V is the attractive force per unit mass. Hence:
- (1) curl v = 0, i.e. dx1'/dy - dy1'/dx = 0, dx1'/dz - dz1'/dx = 0, dy1'/dz - dz1'/dy = 0;
- (2) from (i): div v = -4*pi*rho;
- (3) from (iii): r*x1' = r*y1' = r*z1' = 0 at r = infinity. This takes n to be an arbitrary direction, so all components decay faster than 1/r.

(C) Lagrangian versus Eulerian description (right column). Label particles by their coordinates (xi,eta,zeta) in the 'physical space' (their positions at a reference instant).
- The motion is x = x(xi,eta,zeta,t), etc.
- Hence the velocity is dx/dt = x1'(xi,eta,zeta,t).
- Eliminating the labels gives x1' = x1'(x,y,z,t), etc. This is the Eulerian velocity field, to which conditions (1)-(3) are to apply.

(D) Continuation (next page). The converse: any field satisfying (1)-(3) is the gravitational field.
- (1) gives a potential U.
- (2) gives Laplacian(U) = -4*pi*rho.
- (3) gives dU/ds = w/r^2 along an arc s = r*phi on the sphere at infinity. So U varies on that sphere only by integral of w dphi / r -> 0, and U can be normalised to 0 at infinity.
- Then U = V by uniqueness for the Poisson equation.
The page then begins the treatment of the physical space as light medium: transverse plane waves, with ether density unchanged.
errors: Uniform-density claim: with div v = -4*pi*rho the continuity equation gives D(sigma)/Dt = 4*pi*rho*sigma != 0 inside matter. The ether density stays constant only where rho = 0, unless one adds Riemann's hypothesis (stated elsewhere, not here) that ether is annihilated or absorbed in ponderable bodies.
Notational clash: rho denotes both mass density (Laplacian V = -4*pi*rho) and the surface normal (dV/drho). Harmless but confusing.
Condition (3) on all three velocity components follows from r*dV/dn -> 0 only if n is allowed to range over all directions, not just the normal of one fixed surface. This is implicit.

Condition (iii) is redundant for uniqueness of V: Poisson plus V -> 0 at infinity already determines V. It is needed in the converse argument only to show that a potential built from the velocity field tends to a constant at infinity.
Sign: velocity = +grad V means the ether flows toward the masses (inflow). This is consistent with the sink picture, but the parenthetical 'or opposite' leaves the sign open.

results.what: Hypothesis: the ether velocity field equals the Newtonian gravitational field; the same ether carries light; matter-free space keeps uniform ether density
results.modern_name: Ether-sink (inflow) model of gravitation; precursor of 'river model'/fluid analogies
results.usually_credited_to: Riemann (Nachlass fragment 'Gravitation und Licht', Werke 1876); similar ideas in Challis and Bjerknes

results.what: Potential characterised by Laplacian V = -4*pi*rho, V -> 0 and r*dV/dn -> 0 at infinity; converse uniqueness
results.modern_name: Poisson equation with decay conditions; uniqueness of the Newtonian potential (Green/Gauss/Dirichlet)

results.what: Field v = grad V equivalent to curl v = 0, div v = -4*pi*rho, r*v -> 0
results.modern_name: Helmholtz-type decomposition / determination of a vector field from curl and divergence

results.what: Particle motion x(xi,eta,zeta,t) rewritten as velocity field v(x,y,z,t)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of Riemann's known ether-flow theory of gravitation and light, published in substance among the Werke's naturphilosophische Fragmente. The mathematics (Poisson equation, curl/div characterisation, Lagrange-Euler) is standard for the 1850s. Its value lies in showing the draft stage of his formulation, not in any new result.

transcription_corrections: Line 1: the struck 'Nimmt man' has an interlinear replacement; 'Ausdruck ist' is doubtful. The sense is '[Ist] im ganzen Weltraume ein homogener Stoff vertheilt'.
'Schwerkräften' should read 'Schwerkräfte' (or 'Schwerkraft'); the phrase is 'der in demselben geometrischen Punkt wirkenden Schwerkräfte'.
'Deshalb nenne ich diesen Stoff den physischen Raum heissen' should read 'Deshalb will ich diesen Stoff den physischen Raum heissen'.
'(rho Normale of einer Fläche' should read '(rho Normale auf einer Fläche)'.
'r Entfernung v. Coordinaten Anfangspunkte' means 'vom Coordinatenanfangspunkte'.
The struck '[-alpha-]' before -4*pi*rho in (2) is a cancelled stroke, not a symbol of the formula.
The final lines read: 'Aus der letzten Bedingung r_inf dV/drho = 0 folgt: r_inf x1'=0; r_inf y1'=0; r_inf z1'=0 ... (3'. The transcription splits this out of order.

Right column: 'x=(xi,eta,zeta,t)' denotes 'x is a function of (xi,eta,zeta,t)'. The struck phrase defines xi,eta,zeta as coordinates 'des physischen Raumes (d.h. die Lage der einzelnen Stofftheilchen)'.
The subscript in x1' is probably a prime-index notation x'_1 or simply x'.
